updatePolicy: Only install an upstream-derived update after all guarded requirements and tests pass.
requirements: Keep the Simplified Chinese application identity and localized UI.
Keep the Windows mini floating bar at 396x52 logical window size with a borderless 396x52 content bar.
Keep the matte translucent rounded panel appearance without a hard screenshot-like rectangle.
Keep visible Codex usage, progress, pacing reminder, expand, manual refresh, settings, and hide controls.
Keep the Codex rolling 5-hour and 7-day limits visible as separate quota windows.
Keep pacing judgments separate for the 5-hour and 7-day windows, and label the affected period explicitly in the compact alert.
Keep today, current reset-window, and locally discoverable account-history token totals in the expanded panel.
Keep clickable cached, non-cached input, and output/reasoning token classifications for today and the current reset window.
Keep the expanded local cost card clickable, with today and 30-day estimates shown in both USD and CNY plus the reference exchange rate and estimate disclaimer.
When cost details expand, automatically scroll the dashboard downward to reveal the currency table after native resizing settles.
Keep the desktop floating-window toggle visible at the top of Settings.
Keep background quota refresh at five minutes and expose the interval in Settings.
Keep launch-at-login disabled unless the user explicitly turns it on.
Do not install an official upstream binary over the customized build.
Install and open a successfully rebuilt customized Windows version, and retain only its latest installer.
If integration, tests, packaging, or visual verification fails, keep the installed stable version unchanged and report the blocker.
